_about: Public-domain Carl Ullmann (1796-1865, Heidelberg theologian) in English for the Word Hoard: Gregory of Nazianzum, tr. G. V. Cox (1851), Reformers before the Reformation, tr. Robert Menzies (2 vols, 1855), The Sinlessness of Jesus (1858, R. C. Lundin Brown's translation) and The Essence of Christianity, tr. J. Bleasdell (1860), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 29 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

ullmann-gregory-nazianzum: Gregory of Nazianzum, tr. G. V. Cox (London: John W. Parker, MDCCCLI)
ullmann-reformers-1: Reformers before the Reformation, vol. I, tr. Robert Menzies (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, 1855)
ullmann-reformers-2: Reformers before the Reformation, vol. II, tr. Robert Menzies (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLV)
ullmann-sinlessness-of-jesus: The Sinlessness of Jesus: an Evidence for Christianity, translated from the sixth German edition (Edinburgh: T. & T. Clark, MDCCCLVIII)
ullmann-essence-christianity: The Essence of Christianity, tr. J. Bleasdell (London: Hatchard, MDCCCLX)
